questions.question: For a 1-second signal at 16 kHz, frame_size=400, and hop=160, how many frames does frame_signal create?
questions.explanation: The starts run through 15,600 inclusive in steps of 160, so floor((16,000-400)/160)+1 = 98 frames.

questions.question: What are the frame duration and hop duration represented by FRAME_SIZE=400 and HOP=160 at 16 kHz?
options: 16 ms frames and 4 ms hops
10 ms frames and 25 ms hops
400 ms frames and 160 ms hops
25 ms frames and 10 ms hops
questions.explanation: 400/16,000 seconds is 25 ms; 160/16,000 seconds is 10 ms.

questions.question: What does pad_or_clip do when 5 seconds of frames are passed with target=3000?
options: It keeps the 5-second frames and appends zero frames until the list has 3000 entries
It rescales each frame to 3000 samples
It repeats the waveform until it reaches 30,000 seconds
It drops every frame after the first 3000 even when the input is shorter
questions.explanation: The 5-second input has fewer than 3000 frames, so the function appends zero-valued frames to reach the fixed Whisper window.

questions.question: Which token list does whisper_prompt(lang="fr", task="translate", timestamps=False) produce?
options: <|fr|>, <|transcribe|>, <|timestamps|>
<|startoftranscript|>, <|fr|>, <|translate|>, <|notimestamps|>
<|startoftranscript|>, <|en|>, <|translate|>
<|startoftranscript|>, <|fr|>, <|transcribe|>, <|endoftext|>
questions.explanation: The function always starts with startoftranscript, then inserts the language and task tokens and adds notimestamps when timestamps is false.

questions.question: What does frame_energy use as its toy stand-in for mel power?
options: A softmax over the 400 sample values
The maximum sample divided by the frame length
log(sum(v*v for v in frame) + 1e-9)
The number of zero crossings in the frame
questions.explanation: frame_energy sums squared samples and applies a natural logarithm after adding a small floor.

questions.question: Why does the demo set TARGET_FRAMES=3000 for MAX_SECONDS=30?
options: It makes every frame 3,000 samples long
It allocates one frame per audio sample at 100 Hz
It gives 30 frames per second only when the sample rate is 400 Hz
A 10 ms hop across 30 seconds gives roughly 3,000 transformer input time steps
questions.explanation: Whisper's 10 ms hop corresponds to about 100 frames per second, so 30 seconds is represented by 3,000 frame positions.
